headline: TV Today Network announces resignation of Chief Synergy Officer Shailesh Shekhar Sinha
hook: Leadership exit at TV Today Network
summary: TV Today Network Limited has informed the stock exchanges that Mr. Shailesh Shekhar Sinha will step down from his role as Chief Synergy Officer (Senior Management Personnel) effective October 15, 2026. This is a routine senior management departure within the company. Indian retail investors holding shares of the broadcaster should note executive changes as part of standard corporate governance tracking.
why_it_matters: Routine management exit with minimal impact on stock value
